title: Visually check table row-selected color via LogsTable's 'scroll to row' feature
answers: How do I visually inspect the table's selected-row highlight color?
How was the row-selected background color validated for the visual refresh theme?
body: To see the TableNG row-selected background in context, use the 'scroll to row' feature exposed by LogsTable — it programmatically selects/scrolls to a row, which renders with theme.components.table.rowSelectedBackground applied. This was used to visually verify the rowSelectedBackground values picked for visual_refresh_dark.json and visual_refresh_light.json before merging, since the selected state isn't otherwise easy to trigger manually.
applies: Manual/visual QA of TableNG row-selection colors

search: Verifying TableNG row-selected background color visually uses LogsTable's 'scroll to row' feature, which programmatically selects a row and renders it with theme.components.table.rowSelectedBackground. This is the practical way to test row-selection colors before merging, since the selected state is otherwise difficult to trigger manually. Theme colors are defined in packages/grafana-data/src/themes/themeDefinitions/visual_refresh_dark.json and visual_refresh_light.json. Applies only to manual/visual QA of TableNG row-selection.
